enemies.name: Touch of the Sanguinarch
enemies.flavour_text: A creation of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' Originium Arts, flexible and difficult to defeat. According to rumors, the Sanguinarch is able to snatch the blood of other creatures, imbuing new life into it and taking it under his control.

abilities.text: Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)
Units blocking it gain +1 Block (up to a maximum of +6)

enemies.name: Touch of Benevolence
enemies.flavour_text: One of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' more elaborate creations, flexible and difficult to defeat. According to rumors, the Sanguinarch is able to snatch the blood of other creatures, imbuing new life into it and taking it under his control. Those given new life should praise the Sanguinarch for his benevolence.

abilities.text: Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)
Units blocking it gain +1 Block (up to a maximum of +6)

enemies.name: Gift of the Sanguinarch
enemies.flavour_text: A creation of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' Originium Arts that bears greater vitality. One who was powerful in life will continue to be a great threat to their enemies even after being reshaped by the power of the Sanguinarch's blessing.

abilities.text: Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)
Units blocking it gain +1 Block (up to a maximum of +6)

enemies.name: Gift of Magnanimity
enemies.flavour_text: A creation of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' Originium Arts that bears exceptional vitality. One who was powerful in life will continue to be a great threat to their enemies even after being reshaped by the power of the Sanguinarch's blessing. Therefore, those who continue ought to thank the Sanguinarch for his magnanimity.

abilities.text: Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)
Units blocking it gain +1 Block (up to a maximum of +6)

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Warrior
enemies.flavour_text: A warrior of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed with the living blood of the Sanguinarch of Vampires. After falling in battle for the first time, his blood will continue to advance in his place.

abilities.text: Will be reborn as a <Touch of the Sanguinarch> after falling in battle for the first time

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Warrior Captain
enemies.flavour_text: A captain of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed with the living blood of the Sanguinarch of Vampires, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Royal Court Soldier. After falling in battle for the first time, his blood will continue to advance in his place.

abilities.text: Will be reborn as a <Touch of Benevolence> after falling in battle for the first time

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Artificer
enemies.flavour_text: An artificer of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed with the living blood of the Sanguinarch of Vampires. They gained a portion of Victoria's engineering expertise and are responsible for operating the reloading system of Londinium's city defense artillery.

abilities.text: Continuously charges up Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery; when interrupted, the Defense Artillery will lose a portion of its charge progress
Will be reborn as a <Touch of the Sanguinarch> after falling in battle for the first time

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Artificer Captain
enemies.flavour_text: An artificer captain of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed with the living blood of the Sanguinarch of Vampires. They gained a great amount of Victoria's engineering expertise and are responsible for operating the reloading system of Londinium's city defense artillery.

abilities.text: Continuously charges up Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery; when interrupted, the Defense Artillery will lose a portion of its charge progress
Will be reborn as a <Touch of Benevolence> after falling in battle for the first time

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer ASV
enemies.flavour_text: An armored supply vehicle blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. While on the battlefield, enhances Gift of the Sanguinarch and Touch of the Sanguinarch.

abilities.text: While in battle, Reborn Creations have increased ATK, and their attacks will additionally deal Necrosis

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Retrofit ASV
enemies.flavour_text: An armored supply vehicle meticulously blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. While on the battlefield, enhances Gift of the Sanguinarch and Touch of the Sanguinarch.

abilities.text: While in battle, Reborn Creations have increased ATK, and their attacks will additionally deal Necrosis

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Chain Caster
enemies.flavour_text: A caster of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. Trained by the Royal Court, they pose a wide-ranging threat on the battlefield with their Arts.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Necrosis and jump between 4 targets, with each jump dealing reduced damage
Will be reborn as a <Gift of the Sanguinarch> after falling in battle for the first time

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Chain Caster Captain
enemies.flavour_text: A caster captain of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires, more experienced than a normal Caster. Trained by the Royal Court, they pose a wide-ranging threat on the battlefield with their Arts.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Necrosis and jump between 4 targets, with each jump dealing reduced damage
Will be reborn as a <Gift of Magnanimity> after falling in battle for the first time

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Hatedrinker
enemies.flavour_text: A soldier of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. The hatred of their compatriots slain on the battlefield builds up within them, making them more than eager to tear apart the enemies of the Sarkaz.

abilities.text: Gains increased ATK for each Reborn Creation on the battlefield
Will be reborn as a <Gift of the Sanguinarch> after falling in battle for the first time

enemies.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Wrathgorger
enemies.flavour_text: An elite soldier of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. The wrath of their compatriots slain on the battlefield builds up within them, making them more than eager to tear apart every last enemy of the Sarkaz.

abilities.text: Gains increased ATK for each Reborn Creation on the battlefield
Will be reborn as a <Gift of Magnanimity> after falling in battle for the first time

enemies.name: Sarkaz Requisitioned Engineering Drone
enemies.flavour_text: An engineering drone requisitioned by the Sarkaz Royal Court. They are a part of Londinium's defense system, modified to be more stealthy, but at the cost of greater wear-and-tear.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Invisible, gradually loses HP over time
Attacks charge Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery

enemies.name: Sarkaz Requisitioned Cutting-Edge Drone
enemies.flavour_text: A more sophisticated engineering drone requisitioned by the Sarkaz Royal Court. They are a part of Londinium's defense system, modified to be more stealthy, but at the cost of greater wear-and-tear.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Invisible, gradually loses HP over time
Attacks charge Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery

enemies.name: Bloodthirsty Heir
enemies.flavour_text: A creation of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' Originium Arts. They always thirst for more blood, strengthening themselves by stealing the blood of others.

abilities.text: Attacks restore HP proportional to damage dealt

enemies.name: Engorged Heir
enemies.flavour_text: A creation of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' Originium Arts. Though their bodies are already engorged with the blood of others, their thirst never ceases.

abilities.text: Attacks restore HP proportional to damage dealt

enemies.name: Sarkaz Royal Court Soldier
enemies.flavour_text: A soldier of the Sarkaz Royal Court. Londinium's munitions factories work day and night to produce weapons for the Sarkaz war effort. They boast a distinctly Sarkaz fighting style, but with greater discipline.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Necrosis

enemies.name: Sarkaz Royal Court Elite Soldier
enemies.flavour_text: An elite soldier of the Sarkaz Royal Court. Under Manfred's training, they are not only more formidable warriors, but also more professional.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Necrosis

enemies.name: Manfred
enemies.flavour_text: A young Sarkaz general, member of the Military Commission of Kazdel. After enlisting a large number of mercenaries in Londinium, he has assembled and trained a brand new type of fighting force. His Arts Unit 'Teekazwurtzen' was bestowed upon him by Theresis, the Regent of Kazdel, who also taught him the swordsmanship he now employs.

abilities.text: Deals Arts damage with his floating cannon, attacks charge up Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery
[Military Training] Has high Physical and Arts dodge, but after being bombarded by the Defense Artillery, temporarily loses this dodge effect and is stunned for a period of time
First Form
[Focus] Continuously gains ASPD when attacking the same target (this effect is capped), resets when switching targets or not attacking for a few seconds
Second Form

[From Withered Trunk, New Branches] When defeated for the first time, randomly attacks all targets on the battlefield with his floating cannon, greatly accelerating the charge rate of Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery
In his second form, draws his sword alongside his floating cannon to perform simultaneous Physical and Arts attacks
